description: No clean concept found. Firing is diffuse: it is more common early (ply under ~16), when I have no threat cells of my own, and in openings where columns 2 and 5 hold stones while center columns 3 and 4 are still empty (e.g. me at col 2, opponent at cols 1 and 5). It is not left-right symmetric and depends on move order. The rule captures little of the firing.
effect: None measurable: zeroing or maxing the unit changes move probabilities by at most 0.04.
notes: 4 score calls, all F1 ~0.09 (best 0.091, AUROC 0.556; sim share 0.00). Tried: low ply + no own threats; additive height cues; opening cols2/5-occupied-center-empty + opponent-has-threats; col6/col0 low. Exhaustive ply-4 scan: center-empty openings fire 12.5% vs 0.9%, mirror correlation only 0.08, stone order matters. Valley and opponent-vertical-three hypotheses failed minimal pairs. Firing midgame positions often look forced/lost per engine, not expressible in the board API. Likely a distributed or random direction. Best synth 2.897 < dev max 2.947.
